data.long_meaning: The name Khurshed is derived from Persian origin and translates to 'ruler of the universe'. This powerful and majestic name is believed to bring prosperity, leadership, and protection. The name Khurshed carries the meaning “Ruler of the Universe” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses.
